publicationStatusPolicy: Prefer latest uniquely published Totalizado log. If no final version exists, a single unique published Recebido log is included provisionally, with a source-status warning and internal event reconciliation; this is not a claim of signature verification. Clock-discontinuous sections retain reconciled ballot totals in the unclassified time bucket.

methodology.metric: Presidential ballot confirmation and automatic-null records
methodology.timestampBasis: Voting-machine clock, normalized to Brasília time for domestic sections
methodology.reconciliation: Presidential event count must equal completed voter-session count within each included section; this is internal log reconciliation, not yet a comparison against every official result bulletin.

bucketDefinitions.unclassified: Overseas clock offsets not inferred, or timestamp cannot be normalized

limitations: This is a partial observed dataset until coverage reaches 100%; missing and quarantined sections are not estimated.
A vote recorded after 17:00 is not proof it depended on the extension: voters already in line could legally vote after 17:00.
Machine-clock timestamps may differ from the exact instant a person cast a ballot.
No candidate choice is inferred from timestamped logs. Blank and null ballots are included.
Overseas records are retained separately and are unclassified in the Brasília cutoff buckets.
Downloaded ZIP CRC checks and SHA-256 fingerprints are used; the TSE digital signature envelope has not been independently verified.
